استعطين (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَيْنَ (istaʕṭayna) /is.taʕ.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اُسْتُعْطِينَ (ustuʕṭīna) /us.tuʕ.tˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اِسْتَعْطِينَ (istaʕṭīna) /is.taʕ.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
